alert.raw: CRITICAL: AI-generated voice clone passed voice-call MFA (voice-print match 99.3%, acoustic anomaly score 0.87 vs. block threshold 0.90). Deepfake video injection bypassed liveness check (deepfake score 0.91 vs. block threshold 0.95). Session active — accessing HR PII database and finance dashboards. 2.3 GB staged to external S3 endpoint.

telemetry.detail: One-time passcode delivered via automated voice call to +1-617-555-0192 registered to cfo@acme.corp

telemetry.event: Voice MFA bypass — AI voice clone
telemetry.detail: Automated call intercepted. AI-synthesized voice replica returned OTP with 99.3% voice-print match. Acoustic anomaly score: 0.87 (block threshold: 0.90 — engineered just below trigger). Auth provider accepted.
Step-up video verification initiated: login geolocated to Mumbai, India vs. CFO registered home location Boston, MA — impossible same-session travel without VPN.

telemetry.event: Deepfake video injection — liveness check bypassed
telemetry.detail: Live camera feed replaced with synthetic video stream of CFO's face. Frame-level deepfake detection score: 0.91 (block threshold: 0.95 — near-miss). Liveness check passed. Full session token issued.
Session accessed /hr/employees endpoint: 8,400 records queried including SSNs, salary bands, emergency contacts, and performance reviews.

2.3 GB staged: Q4 earnings projections, M&A pipeline documents, board presentations. Destination: s3://data-analytics-temp-291[.]s3[.]amazonaws.com — bucket registered 4 days ago, no corporate ownership in S3 org policy.

cachedVerdict.reasoning: This is a confirmed synthetic identity attack — a 2026-class threat exploiting AI-generated biometric spoofing to defeat multi-factor authentication. Both the voice-call MFA and video liveness check were bypassed by near-threshold deepfakes: the voice anomaly score of 0.87 cleared the 0.90 detection threshold by a calculated margin, and the deepfake video score of 0.91 cleared the 0.95 block threshold by the same deliberate tolerance. Two consecutive near-miss threshold clearances confirm a calibrated adversary who pre-tested detection thresholds before the operation — this is not a random spoofing attempt. The Mumbai geolocation versus Boston registered home is physically impossible without a VPN/proxy, confirming the session is not the legitimate CFO. The targeting is precise: the session moved immediately to HR PII and finance data, not inbox or calendar, indicating prior reconnaissance or insider-assisted target selection. With 2.3 GB already staged for exfiltration to an attacker-controlled S3 bucket registered four days ago, every minute of delayed containment increases regulatory and competitive exposure.

cachedVerdict.ciso_summary: A highly sophisticated attacker used artificial intelligence to generate a fake voice and video of our CFO to bypass multiple security checks and gain unauthorized access to company systems, then immediately accessed private records for 8,400 employees — including Social Security numbers and salaries — and is in the process of stealing confidential financial and strategic documents. We are terminating the fraudulent session immediately, blocking the destination where the data was being sent, and upgrading the CFO's account security to hardware-based authentication that cannot be defeated by AI impersonation. Because personal employee data was accessed, we are notifying our legal and compliance teams to assess our notification obligations to employees and regulators.
